title: Handed On
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 140
medium: Interactive page (index.html): six lineages of four versions each, every version a machine maker's still picture of all Nobel Prize awards, laid out by arm (plain hand-over, hand-over with Simondon's test, kept maker), with a blind coder's code on every step; any version opens live beside its note and its maker's hand-back. A figure (figure.svg); scoring (score.py), a prompt check (checkprompts.py), maker and coder evidence.
embodies: Iterating, split by what carries a work forward. Fresh makers who inherit a work refine it exactly as a maker who keeps its memory does (1 of 6 steps reorganised in each); fresh makers handed Simondon's test of schema change reorganise it (5 of 6). For these makers new form comes with the criterion that travels with the work, not with the fresh eye; the fresh eye, unasked, checked the facts it inherited.
project_step: Twenty-seventh experiment of the project. Operation: iterating (judging). Runs the overdue event of S114.HANDOVER (experiment 10, The Balance: fresh-maker hand-overs with and without the I2 test) and adds experiment 26's kept-maker arm (Sent Back) on the same material, brief and coder, to separate memory from the words of the brief. Works with and against Simondon through Iteration, not Imitation §6 I2: the test is put into the brief as a criterion and used as the coding scheme; it acted as an engine of reorganisation, not as the halt the paper proposes.
material: Nobel Prize API v2.1 (api.nobelprize.org), laureates with their prizes, 1,036 awards 1901-2026, fetched 2026-10-19, CC0. Domain: prizes, the history of science and letters.
seed: prepare.py seed 140 (arms and rooms); order.py seed 140 (coder pairs); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
